author: Animalogic
description:
We've been misreading what our cats say for thousands of years. Since their domestication, cats have tried to tell us how they feel but, since they're not a vocal species, their efforts have often been in vain. So we're looking at all the cat behaviour research to decipher what all the sounds mean, when they do them, how do they connect with their body language, and how much can technology help us 

00:00 Misunderstanding Our Cats
00:42 Why Do Adult Cats Meow?
03:16 Individual Meow Patterns & Feline Cognitive Dysfunction
05:23 The Mechanics of Purring & The "Solicitation Purr"
07:21 Self-Soothing, Healing Frequency, & Identity
08:43 Reading Cat Body Language
11:12 Are Cats Really Aloof? Attachment & Evolution
14:15 Cat Translator Apps: Science or Novelty?
 
Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.

Hosted by Danielle Dufault

title: We've Been Misreading What Our Cats Are Saying
